subject: art-design
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel A-Level Art & Design specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

units.name: Personal Investigation (Component 1)
units.blurb: Practical portfolio, supporting studies and a written personal study, assessed across all four AOs

units.name: Externally Set Assignment (Component 2)
units.blurb: Preparatory studies leading to a 15-hour supervised final outcome

units.name: Titles & Endorsements
units.blurb: The broad Art, Craft and Design title plus five endorsed disciplines that frame both components

topics.name: Supporting Studies
topics.blurb: Development portfolio of research, investigation and idea generation

topics.name: Practical Work
topics.blurb: Practical outcomes that realise the chosen line of enquiry

topics.name: Personal Study
topics.blurb: Written element of min. 1000 words of continuous prose with critical, contextual understanding

topics.name: AO1 — Develop Ideas
topics.blurb: Sustained, focused investigation informed by contextual and other sources

topics.name: AO2 — Refine & Experiment
topics.blurb: Explore and select media, materials, techniques and processes; review and refine

topics.name: AO3 — Record
topics.blurb: Record ideas, observations and insights relevant to intentions

topics.name: AO4 — Present a Response
topics.blurb: A personal, meaningful response that realises intentions and connects visual elements

topics.name: Preparatory Studies
topics.blurb: Portfolio of practical and written work responding to the externally set theme

topics.name: Sustained Focus Final Piece
topics.blurb: 15-hour supervised period producing the final outcome(s) from preparatory studies

topics.name: Art, Craft and Design (Unendorsed)
topics.blurb: Broad-based title drawing on at least two endorsed disciplines

topics.name: Fine Art
topics.blurb: Painting, drawing, printmaking, sculpture and related fine-art disciplines

topics.name: Graphic Communication
topics.blurb: Advertising, illustration, typography and graphic design disciplines

topics.name: Textile Design
topics.blurb: Textiles for interiors, fine-art textiles, fashion and constructed/printed textiles

topics.name: Three-dimensional Design
topics.blurb: Spatial, product, environmental and other 3D design disciplines

topics.name: Photography
topics.blurb: Film-based, digital, moving-image and lens-based photography disciplines

connections.why: The broad Art, Craft and Design title is built from at least two of the five endorsed disciplines such as Fine Art
Art, Craft and Design candidates combine disciplines, often drawing on Graphic Communication
Textile Design is one of the endorsed routes an Art, Craft and Design portfolio may draw on
Three-dimensional Design can be one of the disciplines combined in the broad title
Photography is one of the lens-based disciplines available to an Art, Craft and Design candidate
The chosen endorsement defines the discipline and media of the practical portfolio
Supporting studies are where AO1 contextual investigation and idea development are evidenced
The contextual research that drives AO1 underpins the critical written personal study
Research and experiments in supporting studies feed directly into practical outcomes
Ideas developed from sources are then explored, selected and refined through media experimentation
Experimenting with media generates the observations and insights AO3 asks students to record
Recorded observations and reflections are resolved into the personal final response of AO4
Media skills selected and refined in AO2 are deployed to realise the AO4 final outcome
AO4 is evidenced by the realised practical outcomes of the portfolio
The written personal study and practical work are integrally connected, informing one another
Skills and methods built in the Component 1 portfolio are reapplied in Component 2 preparatory work
The same investigative, source-led approach scaffolds preparatory studies in the externally set assignment
The 15-hour final piece extends directly from the preparatory studies
All four AOs are reassessed in Component 2, with AO1 investigation driving the preparatory phase
The sustained-focus final outcome is the principal evidence for AO4 in Component 2
Students follow their endorsed discipline across both components, so the title shapes Component 2 too
